name: Hotel Xcaret Arte
positioning: All-Fun Inclusive hotel in front of the Caribbean Sea, conceived as an homage to Mexico's artistic wealth, with suites spread across six artistic Casas
best_for: Adults who want art, culture and wellness on a Caribbean beachfront
Travelers who want unlimited access to the Grupo Xcaret parks included in their stay

facts.text: Hotel Xcaret Arte stands in front of the Caribbean Sea.
The hotel is conceived as an homage to Mexico's artistic wealth.
Each suite category features contemporary Mexican interior design, organic amenities and artistic expressions that pay homage to Mexican culture.
River Suites overlook the emerald river that runs alongside the hotel.
Ocean Front Suites have a direct view of the Caribbean Sea.
The Presidential suite has two bedrooms, multiple terraces and curated artisanal spaces.
All suites include the All-Fun Inclusive concept, which includes unlimited access to the Grupo Xcaret parks.
The All-Fun Inclusive parks are Xcaret, Xel-Ha, Xplor, Xplor Fuego, Xenses, Xoxi and Xenotes.
Guests can join art workshops in textiles, pottery and Latin dance.
Muluk Spa's hydrotherapy ritual includes a sauna, steam room, cold and hot plunges, breeze showers, a cold chamber and a pool with river views.
At Le Chique, Chef Jonatan Gomez Luna serves a 27-course tasting menu of contemporary Mexican cuisine.

highlights.text: Muluk Spa is set among natural rock formations blended with jungle paths and emerald waters.
Muluk Spa has massage stalls in natural caves.
Each of the hotel's 6 Casas hosts different Mexican artistic expressions.
Some suite categories have a Swim Up option with direct access to the pool or rivers from the suite's terrace.
The suites are inspired by renowned artists from Mexico's history.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the property is adults-only and not suitable for families with children.
The painting workshop is reserved for guests of Casa de los Artistas.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
